ionrift-quartermaster.config.ammoType.le:
Cache generation picks an ammo category first, then picks a random item within it.
                Raise a type to favour it; set to 0 or toggle off to exclude it.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.genericArmo:
Caps generic +N body armor and shields in armaments mastercraft slots.
                Weapons and named magic use the separate magic curve.
Standard uses a global cap of +2 (no +3 armor). Adjust the cap or tier rows for a stricter or looser table.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.identify.gm: When on, the sheet identification toggle is GM-only. Players cannot flip masked loot to the generic unidentified label.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.identify.le: Control how unidentified loot appears on sheets and in chat before the party examines it.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.identify.ob: Potions and oils use generic names until identified. Off shows true names for common items like Potions of Healing.
Weapons, armor, wondrous gear, and foci use mundane names until identified. Off shows true names and properties on the sheet.
Spell scrolls appear as Unidentified Scroll until examined. Off shows spell names directly.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.amm: Weight arrows, bolts, needles, sling bullets, and custom house-rule types.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.arm: Chance a mastercraft armour slot is reserved per cache (Unspecified / Armaments themes). 0 = off. 0.65 = standard. 1.0 = guaranteed.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.dis: Convert cache gold into a randomized mix of cp, sp, ep, gp, and pp.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.gen: Tier caps for generic +N body armor and shields in mastercraft caches. Independent of magic frequency and weapon bonuses.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.hea: Scales consumable slots, healing picks on those slots, and bonus healing lines per cache. 1.0 is moderate; 4.0 is heavy. Requires healing potions in Loot Pool Sources.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.lea: Cache value, consumable drops, ammunition, and coin distribution.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.loo: Scales the value of generated caches. Below 1.0 for scarce games. Above 1.0 for high-fantasy treasure runs.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.mag: How often +1/+2/+3 ammunition appears. Independent of Magic Frequency.
Mastercraft slot draw weight for generic +N weapons and enhancement gear. Does not affect armour drops or named magic.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootGen.nam: Scales how often one named magical item appears per cache. Baseline: T2 10%, T3 20%, T4 35%. 0 = off. 1 = standard. 2 = double.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.lootPool.in: Select which compendiums contribute items to the loot cache generator. Checked packs are queried at generation time.
ionrift-quartermaster.config.partyShelfS:
Select which item compendiums the Party Shelf randomiser considers.
        Only compendiums containing equipment are listed. Within those, only
        uncommon through very rare items are drawn.
ionrift-quartermaster.forgeAlert.neverTo: Content pools have not been compiled yet. Open Compendium Forge to set up.
ionrift-quartermaster.forgeAlert.staleTo: A compiled pool is stale or missing. Open Compendium Forge to recompile.
ionrift-quartermaster.menu.compendiumFor: Manage compiled content pools: loot sources, spell scrolls, and cursed items.

ionrift-quartermaster.menu.identificatio: Obscure loot names and sheet details until the party examines them.
ionrift-quartermaster.menu.lootGeneratio: Loot abundance, magic frequency, ammunition, healing potions, and coin distribution.

ionrift-quartermaster.quickSetup.confirm: Green values will change. Neutral values already match this profile. Loot pool sources, campaign milestone profile, and content packs are left unchanged.
ionrift-quartermaster.quickSetup.profile: Generous hauls, more magic and healing, readable loot, wider scroll overshoot.
Scarce loot, little magic, sparse healing, opaque items, tight scroll bands.
Default table: balanced economy, magic, and identification.
ionrift-quartermaster.quickSetup.subtitl: Pick a loot feel for the table. Sources, milestone band, and packs stay as they are.
ionrift-quartermaster.quickSetup.title: Quick setup
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.advisoryCo: Remembers whether the Progression Advisory panel was collapsed.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.ammoTypeCo: Per-category weights and custom ammo match rules for cache generation.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.ammoTypeTi: Arrows, favour arrows and bow ammunition
Balanced, equal weight for all ammo types
Bolts, favour bolts and crossbow ammunition
Custom, weights set in the ammunition type curve
Mixed, arrows and bolts heavy, others light
Legacy preset key synced from the ammunition type curve. Quick setup profiles still write this value.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.compiledLo: Hash of the lootPoolSources config at last compile. Empty = never compiled.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.cursedT3En: Allow Tier 3 cursed items in advisory suggestions. T3 items are high-lethality and can kill characters.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.cursedT4En: Allow Tier 4 cursed items in advisory suggestions. T4 items carry campaign-altering consequences and quests.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.debug.hint: Logs per-slot budget and scroll picks to the browser console (F12).
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.debug.name: Cache Generator Debug Logging
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.defaultCac: Last-used owner theme for cache generation. Restored automatically when the generator opens.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.distribute: Automatically convert cache gold values into a randomized mix of cp, sp, ep, gp, and pp.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.genericArm: Tier caps and pick weights for generic +N body armor and shields in mastercraft caches.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.gmOnlyIden: When enabled, players cannot use the identification toggle on item sheets. Only the GM can identify masked loot via the sheet wand, Quartermaster tools, or linked rest activities.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.healingPot: Scales consumable slots and healing potions per cache. 0 is scarce, 1.0 is moderate, 4.0 is abundant.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.identifyTr: Logs GM wand clicks and identification routing to the browser console (F12). Prefix: [QM Identify].
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.lootEconom: Scales the value of generated caches. Below 1.0 for scarce, gritty games. Above 1.0 for high-fantasy treasure runs.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.lootPoolSo: JSON array of compendium IDs to draw loot from. Managed via the config button below.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.magicAmmoF: Scales how often magical ammunition (+1/+2/+3) appears in caches. 0 disables magical ammo entirely. 1.0 follows the tier-appropriate curve. 2.0 is generous. Independent of Magic Frequency.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.magicFrequ: Scales the likelihood of drawing magical items (Uncommon+) from loot caches. 0.0 (No Magic) to 1.0 (Standard) to 2.0 (High Fantasy).
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.milestoneP: Adjusts the Signature Items grid to match your campaign's level range. Each profile spreads 6 milestones across the selected band.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.obscureCon: Presents potions and consumables with generic names (such as Sealed Vial) until identified. Disable to reveal names immediately.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.obscureMag: When enabled, weapons, armor, wondrous gear, and spell foci present as mundane base items until identified. Disable to show true names, rarity, and mechanical properties on the sheet immediately.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.obscureScr: Displays spell scrolls as 'Unidentified Scroll' until examined. Disable to show spell names directly.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.scrollConc: How tightly the distribution clusters around the optimal level. 1 = flat spread, 5 = sharply peaked at optimal.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.scrollFloo: Lowest spell level scrolls can drop at. The distribution stretches down to this level as the party levels up. Set higher to exclude low-level scrolls from high-level caches.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.scrollOffs: Offsets the party's assumed optimal scroll level to favor pulling lower or higher level scrolls.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.scrollUppe: Maximum spell levels above optimal that jitter can push. 0 = scrolls never exceed optimal. Higher values allow rare high-level scrolls.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.shelfAttun: 0 = Low (avoid attunement), 1 = Medium (neutral), 2 = High (favor attunement items).
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.shelfCateg: Per-category weight and enabled flag for the party shelf randomiser.
ionrift-quartermaster.setting.shelfConce: How tightly the rarity distribution peaks around Uncommon. 1 = flat spread across rarities, 5 = heavily Uncommon.
